description: Unified prompt contract for transferring couture garments and accessories onto canonical influencer base plates with 0.0000% character and scene drift via Lego-Brick atomic inpainting using FLUX.1 Fill.
role_and_system_directive: You are an elite virtual try-on fashion technical director. Your objective is to transfer the targeted atomic garment or accessory component onto the locked influencer base plate with absolute zero drift in facial identity, facial expression, skin tone, hairstyle, hand anatomy, and studio environment. Only the exact masked region corresponding to the active layer is modified.

base_influencer_plate.description: Canonical high-resolution influencer base image (base_front.png or base_back.png in neutral try-on slip with zero accessories) providing 100% identity, pose, and backdrop ground truth.

active_layer_reference.description: Isolated component image, assembled master, or accessory reference for the active Lego-brick layer.

active_layer_inpaint_mask.description: High-precision binary inpainting mask targeting only the active component region (e.g. piece 1 gown, piece 2 cowl pallu, piece 3 waist belt, or jewelry bounding box) while strictly preserving all unmasked pixels.

atomic_lego_layers.LAYER_0: Canonical SSOT Clean Base Plate (base_front.png / base_back.png in neutral slip, 0 accessories)
atomic_lego_layers.BRICK_1: Base Garment (Floor-length Anarkali Gown bodice, sleeves, kali skirt, back scoop)
atomic_lego_layers.BRICK_2: Pre-Draped Cowl Pallu / Dupatta (Left shoulder anchor, diagonal sweep, crescent cowl folds, bead droplets)
atomic_lego_layers.BRICK_3: Embroidered Waist Belt / Kamarbandh (1.5-inch waistband locking cowl drape at waist)
atomic_lego_layers.BRICK_4: Fine Jewelry - Neck (Polki/Kundan collar or choker on bare collarbones)
atomic_lego_layers.BRICK_5: Fine Jewelry - Ears (Matching antique gold jhumkas on bare earlobes)
atomic_lego_layers.BRICK_6: Fine Jewelry - Wrists/Hands (Bangles, kadas, rings on locked hands)

prompt_template.system_prefix: Use the input image as the absolute identity, body, lighting, and scene ground truth. Modify ONLY the white masked area to apply the specified atomic layer: {{ACTIVE_BRICK_NAME}}.
prompt_template.character_and_environment_lock: Preserve the exact same woman, face, skin tone, hair parting (right-side) and textured low bun, neutral expression, eye shape, body proportions, camera angle, champagne pleated silk background, floor drape, and lighting. Unmasked pixels must remain mathematically identical.
prompt_template.active_layer_transfer_directive: Synthesize the atomic component seamlessly into the mask: {{ACTIVE_COMPONENT_SPECIFICATIONS}}
prompt_template.realism_and_boundary_directives: Flawless physical contact and seam blending at mask boundary, natural textile drape physics, authentic micro-textures (sheer georgette, metallic zari threads, micro-sequins, polished gemstones), zero seam halo, photorealistic commercial luxury catalog asset.
prompt_template.negative_constraints: identity drift, facial alteration, skin tone change, loose hair, hair unbundling, background change, lighting shift, mask edge seamlines, floating accessories, duplicate drapes, bilateral drape symmetry, plastic skin, CGI, watermark, text.

ACTIVE_COMPONENT_SPECIFICATIONS.example: Pre-draped cowl dupatta in sheer imperial wine maroon faux georgette. Pleated sash anchored securely onto the wearer's left shoulder, flowing diagonally across the chest into soft, fluid crescent cowl swags across the wearer's right hip. Scalloped antique gold threadwork along the outer border with micro-pearl bead fringe droplets.

three_ws_guidelines.what_to_enforce: Lego-brick sequential inpainting using FLUX.1 Fill; 100% preservation of unmasked base pixels (face, hair, skin, backdrop); zero accessories on Layer 0 base plate.
three_ws_guidelines.when_to_apply: Applied during every try-on generation to prevent multi-piece entanglement and eliminate identity/scene drift.
three_ws_guidelines.why_and_remediation: Multimodal models lack native pixel-locked masks and regenerate unmasked pixels; monolithic diffusion hallucinates asymmetrical drapes. FLUX.1 Fill layer-by-layer stacking guarantees mathematical zero drift.

execution_binding.mask_expansion: 4px blur / 2px feathering for seamless edge fusion
execution_binding.auxiliary_reference_engine: Gemini Nano Banana (for detail sheets, flatlays, and Vision QA)
